about: One row per piece of UI the mod adds or changes. Each row generates one UiDef. clone_of names an object the mod copies from the game's own scene (found by component, from the scene dump).

columns.text: label text ({best} etc. filled at runtime)
columns.offset_y: world units relative to the cloned object (negative is down); title_overtime: overlap into the logo's bottom edge; title_credit: overlap into OVERTIME's bottom edge; title_buttons_shift: whole title menu moved down
columns.verified: how it was seen in the running game, or 'no'

rows.clone_of: TitleButton '1 Player Button' (index 0 in the title ButtonGroup)

rows.verified: in game 2026-10-09: button under BACK on the Win screen; clicking it started Loop 2 (round 9 scaling, random team)
partial: line shown in game; reworded text not yet seen
